findings.description: Nit: The supposedly exhaustive bug-scrub effort mapping still names shorthand categories (`test`, `deferred`, and `spec`) instead of the actual contract values `test-failure`, `deferred-issue`, and `spec-violation`, leaving those three mappings ambiguous to implement.
findings.resolution: Name all eight exact Category literal values in the effort table and preserve fail-closed handling only for values outside that closed set.

findings.resolution: Add task 0.2 to task 3.3 dependencies so the human-readable execution plan matches the validated work-package DAG.
